const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u,h){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " const hh=Object.assign({Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/json'}, h||{});",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:hh},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "(async function(){",
 " // Postiz 的 GitHub 数据：star 数、开源商业模式",
 " const r=await get('https://api.github.com/repos/gitroomhq/postiz-app');",
 " if(r.status===200){",
 " const j=JSON.parse(r.body);",
 " console.log('Postiz repo:');",
 " console.log(' stars:', j.stargazers_count);",
 " console.log(' forks:', j.forks_count);",
 " console.log(' open issues:', j.open_issues_count);",
 " console.log(' license:', j.license ? j.license.spdx_id : 'none');",
 " console.log(' created:', j.created_at, '| pushed:', j.pushed_at);",
 " console.log(' desc:', j.description);",
 " console.log(' homepage:', j.homepage);",
 " } else { console.log('postiz repo status', r.status); }",
 " await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,3000)});",
 " // 找更多开源+云托管案例",
 " const q='https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=open+source+alternative+in:name,description+stars:>2000&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=15';",
 " const r2=await get(q);",
 " if(r2.status===200){",
 " const j2=JSON.parse(r2.body);",
 " console.log('\\n=== 高星开源替代品项目（可能靠云托管赚钱）===');",
 " for(const it of j2.items){ console.log(' '+it.stargazers_count+'★ '+it.full_name+' — '+(it.description||'').substring(0,80)); }",
 " } else { console.log('search status', r2.status, r2.body.substring(0,200)); }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-postiz.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-postiz.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Postiz repo data and OSS alternatives", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 6000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "function get(u,h){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  const hh=Object.assign({Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/json'}, h||{});",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:hh},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  // Postiz 的 GitHub 数据：star 数、开源商业模式",
  "  const r=await get('https://api.github.com/repos/gitroomhq/postiz-app');",
  "  if(r.status===200){",
  "    const j=JSON.parse(r.body);",
  "    console.log('Postiz repo:');",
  "    console.log('  stars:', j.stargazers_count);",
  "    console.log('  forks:', j.forks_count);",
  "    console.log('  open issues:', j.open_issues_count);",
  "    console.log('  license:', j.license ? j.license.spdx_id : 'none');",
  "    console.log('  created:', j.created_at, '| pushed:', j.pushed_at);",
  "    console.log('  desc:', j.description);",
  "    console.log('  homepage:', j.homepage);",
  "  } else { console.log('postiz repo status', r.status); }",
  "  await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,3000)});",
  "  // 找更多开源+云托管案例",
  "  const q='https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=open+source+alternative+in:name,description+stars:>2000&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=15';",
  "  const r2=await get(q);",
  "  if(r2.status===200){",
  "    const j2=JSON.parse(r2.body);",
  "    console.log('\\n=== 高星开源替代品项目（可能靠云托管赚钱）===');",
  "    for(const it of j2.items){ console.log('  '+it.stargazers_count+'★ '+it.full_name+' — '+(it.description||'').substring(0,80)); }",
  "  } else { console.log('search status', r2.status, r2.body.substring(0,200)); }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-postiz.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-postiz.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Postiz repo data and OSS alternatives", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 6000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
